title: Conditional Aggregation with CASE
description: Create a summary showing how many students got each letter grade (A: >=90, B: >=80, C: >=70, D: >=60, F: <60) for each course. Show course name and count per grade. Return columns: course, a_count, b_count, c_count, d_count, f_count.
hints: Use CASE inside COUNT() for each grade bucket
CASE WHEN score >= 90 THEN 1 END counts A's
